**Risk flags:**
- Single shareholder holds 75.61%

**Overview:**  
Indah Prima Medical Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company operating a community pharmacy and health supplement business in Kelantan, Malaysia. Incorporated on 30 April 1993, it has five directors and a share capital of RM 500,000, with the majority shareholder owning 75.61% of the equity. Reported revenues are RM 5,529,168, RM 5,340,763 and RM 4,835,417 in the three most recent periods, with equity of RM 3,784,631, RM 2,960,195 and RM 1,879,684 respectively. The firm has recorded zero civil or criminal cases, with no claims against it.
